scope: feature/visual-reworks-b: e39d624d (Kaede rework, Yoriko marionette, academy attack FX; git diff 16e78a37...e39d624d) plus the academy placed props merged on top (git diff e39d624d..6a9ecb4b)
summary: Determinism, pooling, dispose, the merges and the fallbacks are sound, and the targeted tests pass. There are three MEDIUM findings: two on Yoriko's marionette, where the owner's spec is missed (Extend is a 4-frame dart, and the Strike whites out), and one where Azami's bite spikes no longer line up with the new 3D strips. All three are display-only fixes. Everything else is LOW.

findings.where: src/render/marionetteLogic.js planStages + aimMarionette; 844x390 and every size
findings.what: The owner's spec says Extend is an arc, but at base speed Extend is a 4-frame dart. Her needle lands about 0.1 s after the attack event, so Command and Extend are squeezed to 0.033 s and 0.067 s while the glide stays at least MIN_REACH = 0.7 tiles: about 10 tiles/s. At 3x game speed that is about 1 real frame, so the doll simply appears at the target. Reel and settle are good.
findings.scenario: Yoriko at rate 0.9 with a slime 1.5 tiles away. In the live strip, the frame after Command already shows the doll at the target (batch-b/yoriko-live-844x390-strip.jpg).
findings.fix: Pre-roll the sequence from the sim's own cooldown (display read only): when t.cooldown <= plan.lead and she has a target in range, start Command early so that Extend ends on the projected hit; the existing land/catch-up logic covers a sooner hit. Failing that, raise LEAD_MIN to about 0.2 s and let the doll's strike trail the sim's hit by up to 0.1 s, firing the slash flash from the doll's strike instead of onImpact.

findings.what: The Strike's slash is lost in a white-out. Two white or near-white slash sprites (0.4–0.5 tiles) plus a white flash() stack on top of the enemy's own white hit flash. At 3.5 attacks/s the enemy stays white nearly all the time (the builder's strip-fast-844x390.jpg) and the two crossed cuts cannot be read.
findings.scenario: Live at 844x390, the struck slimes become a white blob in the strike frame (batch-b/yoriko-live-strike-whiteout-844x390.jpg).
findings.fix: Colour the slash lilac (a lilac core with only a thin white edge), offset it toward the camera in front of the body as Kaede's streak does (towardCamera × 0.3), and drop or greatly shrink the extra flash(). At high rates, skip the slash when the last one on the same enemy is under about 0.15 s old.

findings.what: With the 3D props on, every strip lies across the road, but the bite spikes and ground streak (onTrap trigger and the toss landing) are still laid at the old placeholder's random angle, uid × 0.7. In a live wave the 8 strips had uid × 0.7 mod π of 0.05, 0.07, 0.38, 0.8, 1.43, 2.53, 2.88 and 2.9 rad, so most bites cross the strip at a skew.
findings.scenario: Azami at T3+ on stage 1-1, 8 strips across the road (batch-b/props-live-844x390-zoom2x.jpg): when an enemy triggers one, the spike fan does not run along the plates.
findings.fix: When ctx.actors.placedProps?.covers('strip') is true, take the strip axis from the road: export roadFacing (or add placedProps.stripAxis(uid), which reuses its cached _facing). The strip's long axis is the road normal, (cos f, -sin f) for facing f, matching compose(yaw = f) with local x. Keep uid × 0.7 only for the flat low-graphics drawing, and add a unit test that the bite direction equals the prop's axis.

findings.what: At 3.5 attacks/s the stages floor at 0.3 of base (0.33 s in all), which is longer than the 0.286 s interval. The doll never rests and the settle is always cut by the next attack. The restart from reel or settle is smooth and Command/Extend/Strike (0.15 s) never block an attack, so this is cosmetic.
findings.fix: At high rates, let MIN_SCALE drop to about 0.25, or skip the settle when the interval is under BASE_TOTAL × 0.4.

findings.what: The control bar on her hand does not move. Only the string tops flick up on Command (s.flick), so the Command beat is carried by the strings alone.
findings.fix: Optional: tilt her bar (or her hand bone) by s.flick for 0.1 s. This is not required by the spec.

findings.where: src/render/companions.js _update (the final else branch, about line 588) and const SWOOP_OPTS (line 805)
findings.what: Merge leftovers. The doll returns early into the marionette, so the else branch (sortieStep with DASH_OPTS) is unreachable: the only cids are kon, kaze and doll. SWOOP_OPTS is now declared but never used. Both are harmless, with no behaviour change.
findings.fix: Delete the dead branch and SWOOP_OPTS, plus DASH_OPTS and the doll's old Dream Detour path in _onAttack if nothing else uses them.

findings.what: It allocates a 3-colour array on every bladeArt storm event (const cols = [...]). The event is rare, so the cost is negligible.
findings.fix: Cache the colours on tw.data, as ghostCols already does.

findings.what: At phone size the 2–4 flat-tinted ghosts merge into an orange smear under her that reads more like a flame trail than her silhouette. They work, and they snapshot the camera-facing pose correctly (quaternion copied at spawn), but the shape is not legible at 844x390.
findings.scenario: Kaede lunging toward the camera on a phone.
findings.fix: Optional: on high and medium graphics, keep 2 ghosts spaced further apart (DASH reach × 0.5 / 1.0) at lower opacity (about 0.45 → 0), or add a darker rim colour per ghost.
